title: ApiDataSource
description:
REST API data source for querying external services via HTTP endpoints.
Implements IParametrizedDataSource<ApiDataSourceParameter>.
Enables integration with OpenAPI/Swagger-documented endpoints, supports path/query/header parameters,
JSON response mapping, and request body transformation. Parameters can be populated from component state,
user claims, or pagination settings.

name.description: Gets the unique name identifier for this API data source. Used in component bindings.

endpoint.description:
Gets or sets the OpenAPI endpoint identifier that defines the REST service location.
Example: "https://api.example.gov/v1/services".

operation.description:
Gets or sets the operation name within the OpenAPI definition (e.g., "GetUsers", "CreateSubmission").
This identifies which API operation to invoke.

outputMapping.description:
Gets or sets the JSON schema that defines how the API response is mapped to component fields.
Used for transforming the API response structure into the expected data format.

inputBodyConverter.description:
Gets or sets the converter for transforming component input into the API request body.
Used when the API expects a custom JSON structure derived from component state.

type.description: Gets the data source type. Always DataSourceType.Api.

singleResult.description:
Gets or sets whether this API returns a single object rather than a collection.
When true, array responses are unwrapped to a single object.

allowUnauthorizedAccess.description:
Gets or sets whether this API allows unauthenticated requests.
When true, the request is sent without authorization headers.

parameters.description:
Gets or sets the list of API parameters (path, query, header) to be sent with the request.
Each parameter maps component state or user claims to OpenAPI parameter definitions.

forwardPaginationParameters.description:
Gets or sets whether pagination parameters (page, pageSize, skip, take) should be forwarded to the API.
When true, component pagination settings are appended as query parameters.

ApiParameterOutputType.description:
Specifies how an API parameter is included in the request body or form data.
JSON serialized as string values. Used for POST/PUT/PATCH requests to specify request format.

DataSourceType.description:
Specifies the type of data source, determining how data is fetched and processed.
JSON serialized as string values. Used to classify data sources and route to appropriate executors.

allOf.description:
Defines an API parameter for REST endpoint integration.
Extends DataSourceParameterBase with API-specific configuration for where the parameter is sent (path, query, header)
and whether it is required by the API operation.

isRequired.description:
Gets or sets whether this parameter is required by the API operation.
When true, the parameter value must be provided or the API call will fail.
When false, the parameter can be omitted if not available in the component state.

in.description:
Gets or sets where this parameter is sent in the API request.
Values: Path (URL path segment), Query (URL query string), Header (HTTP header), or None.
Example: Path for ID in "/users/{id}", Query for filters, Header for authorization tokens.

ApiParameterDestinationType.description:
Specifies where an API parameter is placed in the HTTP request.
JSON serialized as string values. Determines how parameter values are included when calling API endpoints.

DataSourceParameterBase.description:
Base class for all data source parameter definitions.
Parameters define how external values (component state, user claims, pagination info) map to data source inputs.
Supports token substitution: ${componentName}, ${item.field}, ${User.attribute}, ~UserID, ~NOW.

sourceName.description:
Gets or sets the source location of the parameter value. Required.
Examples: component name, nested path (item.field), claim name.
Supports token syntax like "${itemValue}", "${User.Id}", "~UserID", "~NOW".

destinationName.description:
Gets or sets the destination name for this parameter in the data source.
For API parameters: the OpenAPI parameter name.
For SQL parameters: the SQL parameter name (with or without @ prefix).
For Table parameters: the filter/search/query field name.
If not specified, defaults to the SourceName.
